description: Authoritative learned proposal runtime and model availability status enum as defined by Architecture Revision 3 Component C-08.

definitions.DISABLED: Learned model inference is administratively disabled or unconfigured; classical core operates unaided.
definitions.LOADING: Model weights, ONNX runtime session, or neural execution provider initializing.
definitions.SHADOW: Model inference executing in non-intrusive shadow mode; proposals logged but not admitted to navigation state.
definitions.ELIGIBLE: Model inference healthy, outputs within uncertainty bounds, and proposals eligible for supervisory gating.
definitions.REJECTED: Model proposal failed validation, out-of-distribution gate, timeout, or innovation bounds check.
definitions.FAILED: Model runtime crashed, execution provider error, or incompatible tensor contract encountered.
